Messages.Body:
During our last gaming session where did once again a starter game the
following situation arose :

Gratiano got a Political Struggle on Meshenka
He attacked and put him into torpor.

What happens ?

- Nothing.
- Gratiano now has 3 votes in the Prisci sub-referendum.

--
johannes walch

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Nothing.

See the rulings:
Priscus (Prisci vote): Prisci in general have zero votes (for effects that
operate based on the number of votes a vampire has). [RTR 19970630]

Or google for
"Political Struggle" Priscus author:LSJ
